verdict.rationale: Programmatic access is a fair question for a credential or authenticator product, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only touch-based UI actions (swipe to edit or delete, drag to reorder, scan QR codes) and account sync. It shows no API exposing these functions, and a community user notes that getting a simple text export is very difficult. The open-source OTP implementations and PAM module are separate components, not an API that matches the app's UI capabilities.
